models.name: Ken Burns Local Video (mobile)
models.description: WORKING mobile video path. Character still + natural 1× pan/zoom + optional TTS. Offline, open-source, safe on 4GB RAM. Produces real MP4 via local compose.
models.status_note: Primary mobile video model. No download. Character-locked, offline.

models.name: Local Agent + Character Pipeline
models.description: Script, scenes, character lock, system prompts. Always on. Pairs with Ken Burns for full offline video.

models.name: MobileI2V (270M) — mobile I2V target
models.description: HUST 270M image-to-video. Designed for phones (2-step, ~720p). Research target when native runtime ships. Not auto-downloaded on 4GB.
models.status_note: Best open mobile diffusion candidate. Native integration pending. Use Ken Burns until then.

models.name: CineMobile (<1GB quant)
models.description: On-device cinematic I2V research model. Quant <1GB, peak ~1.8GB RAM. Desktop/high-end mobile later.
models.status_note: Not packaged for APK download. Avoid on 4GB.

models.name: LTX-Video 2B Distilled (GGUF)
models.description: Open small DiT for desktop CLI. Not for 4GB phones.
models.status_note: Desktop only. Never auto-download on phone.

models.name: CogVideoX-2B
models.description: Desktop GPU only. Too heavy for phones.
